name: EV Charging Stations
description: Electric vehicle charging station locations and connector details from official national feeds, OpenChargeMap, NOBIL, and OpenStreetMap
pricingNote: Direct payment price at this charger — your provider's roaming or subscription price may differ.

ocm.purpose: Global community-maintained EV charging station locations with connector details, power levels, operator info, and per-record data-provider/license attribution
ocm.dataSent: Bounding-box coordinates (south, west, north, east), optional filters (connector type, usage type, status), and the OpenChargeMap API key — sent server-side per map request
ocm.dataReceived: Charging stations with connector types, power levels, operator info, pricing, availability status, and per-record data-provider/license metadata when available

us-afdc.purpose: Official Alternative Fuel Stations dataset (US DOE / NREL) covering public electric charging stations in the United States and Canada
us-afdc.dataSent: Bounding-box centre latitude/longitude plus a derived search radius, the filters fuel_type=ELEC, country=all, status=E, access=public, and the AFDC/NREL API key (in an X-Api-Key header) — sent server-side per map request
us-afdc.dataReceived: Charging station records with location, operator/network, connector types and per-level port counts, access, pricing, opening hours, and status metadata

de-bnetza.purpose: Official German charging station registry (Bundesnetzagentur Ladesäulenregister) covering public charging infrastructure in Germany
de-bnetza.dataSent: No query parameters — the full national CSV dataset is downloaded server-side on a daily schedule into the local database and then queried by bounding box locally; no user data reaches the provider per map request
de-bnetza.dataReceived: Charging station records with location, operator, connector types, rated power, EVSE ids, and operational status

de-ocpdb.purpose: Nationwide German charging data aggregated by MobiData BW (OCPDB) from the Bundesnetzagentur registry and charge point operators via Mobilithek, adding structured ad-hoc tariffs and live availability
de-ocpdb.dataSent: No query parameters carrying user data — the full national OCPI dataset is paged server-side on a schedule into the local database and then queried by bounding box locally; no user data reaches the provider per map request
de-ocpdb.dataReceived: Charging station records with location, operator, connector types, rated power, EVSE ids, live status and availability, and structured per-EVSE tariffs (energy/time price, currency, VAT)

fr-irve.purpose: French national consolidated EV charging dataset (Base nationale consolidée des IRVE) covering public charging points in France
fr-irve.dataSent: Bounding-box coordinates as an in_bbox(point_geo, north, west, south, east) filter with pagination (limit/offset) — sent server-side per map request; no API key
fr-irve.dataReceived: Charging point records with location, operator/owner, connector types, rated power, access conditions, payment methods, pricing, opening hours, and accessibility metadata

ie-esb.purpose: ESB ecars public charging network covering the Republic of Ireland and Northern Ireland
ie-esb.dataSent: No query parameters — the full ESB ecars CSV dataset is downloaded server-side on a daily schedule into the local database and then queried by bounding box locally; no user data reaches the provider per map request
ie-esb.dataReceived: Charging station records with location, county, connector types and per-type counts, rated power, opening hours, and free-text pricing

cy-cynap.purpose: CYNAP public EV charging point register for Cyprus, published by the Department of Electrical and Mechanical Services (EMS)
cy-cynap.dataSent: No query parameters — the full CYNAP DATEX II dataset is downloaded server-side on a daily schedule into the local database and then queried by bounding box locally; no user data reaches the provider per map request
cy-cynap.dataReceived: Charging point records with location, operator/owner, status, connector types and count, rated power, and opening hours

lu-chargy.purpose: Chargy public charging network covering Luxembourg
lu-chargy.dataSent: No query parameters — the full Chargy KML dataset is downloaded server-side on a daily schedule into the local database and then queried by bounding box locally; no user data reaches the provider per map request
lu-chargy.dataReceived: Charging station records with location, address, connector power ratings, and a station-level available/unavailable rollup status

nz-evroam.purpose: EVRoam public charging network for New Zealand, published by Waka Kotahi NZ Transport Agency
nz-evroam.dataSent: No query parameters — the full ArcGIS FeatureServer dataset is downloaded server-side on a daily schedule into the local database and then queried by bounding box locally; no user data reaches the provider per map request
nz-evroam.dataReceived: Charging station records with location, operator/owner, opening hours, connector types (Type 1/Type 2/CCS/CHAdeMO) with power ratings and counts, operational status, and whether charging is free or paid

es-dgt.purpose: Official Spanish national EV charging point registry (DGT National Access Point) covering public charging infrastructure in Spain
es-dgt.dataSent: No query parameters — the full national DATEX II dataset is downloaded server-side on a daily schedule into the local database and then queried by bounding box locally; no user data reaches the provider per map request
es-dgt.dataReceived: Charging site records with location, address, operator, connector types, rated power, current type, and last-updated timestamp

it-pun.purpose: Italian national EV charging registry (PUN — Piattaforma Unica Nazionale, GSE/MASE); license terms are unconfirmed public-sector open data, included provisionally
it-pun.dataSent: No query parameters — the full ArcGIS FeatureServer dataset is downloaded server-side on a daily schedule into the local database and then queried by bounding box locally; no user data reaches the provider per map request
it-pun.dataReceived: EVSE-level charging records (grouped into stations) with location, address, connector standards (Type 1/Type 2/CCS/CHAdeMO) with power ratings, opening hours, and operational status

au-nsw-ev.purpose: Official Transport for NSW register of public EV charging locations across New South Wales
au-nsw-ev.dataSent: No query parameters — the full NSW CSV dataset is downloaded server-side on a daily schedule into the local database and then queried by bounding box locally; no user data reaches the provider per map request
au-nsw-ev.dataReceived: Charging station records with location, operator, local government area, postcode, charger type (AC/DC), rated power, plug count, and operational/planned status

au-qld-ev.purpose: Queensland Department of Transport and Main Roads register of public EV charging sites
au-qld-ev.dataSent: No query parameters — the full Queensland CSV dataset is downloaded server-side on a daily schedule into the local database and then queried by bounding box locally; no user data reaches the provider per map request
au-qld-ev.dataReceived: Charging station records with location, address, and host/operator; no connector-level data

au-vic-ev.purpose: Victorian Government (DEECA) Destination Charger Program register of public EV charging sites
au-vic-ev.dataSent: No query parameters — the full WFS GeoJSON dataset is downloaded server-side on a daily schedule into the local database and then queried by bounding box locally; no user data reaches the provider per map request
au-vic-ev.dataReceived: Charging station records with location, address, region, operator/lead organisation, connector types and counts, and operational/planned status

be-flanders.purpose: Flemish public EV charging point register (Laadpunten) published by the Department of Mobility and Public Works
be-flanders.dataSent: No query parameters carrying user data — the full WFS dataset is paged server-side on a daily schedule into the local database and then queried by bounding box locally; no user data reaches the provider per map request
be-flanders.dataReceived: Charging records with location, operator, connector types, rated power, current type (AC/DC), and address; no live status or pricing

hk-epd.purpose: Official Hong Kong EPD dataset of public electric vehicle chargers covering car parks across Hong Kong
hk-epd.dataSent: No query parameters — the full territory-wide JSON dataset is downloaded server-side on a daily schedule into the local database and then queried by bounding box locally; no user data reaches the provider per map request
hk-epd.dataReceived: Charging station records with location, operator, connector types and per-type counts, opening hours, and enabled/disabled status

fi-digitraffic.purpose: Finnish national EV charging network dataset (Fintraffic / Digitraffic AFIR Charging Network API) covering publicly accessible charging infrastructure in Finland
fi-digitraffic.dataSent: No query parameters — the full national locations feed and its structured tariffs feed are downloaded server-side on a daily schedule into the local database and then queried by bounding box locally; no user data reaches the provider per map request
fi-digitraffic.dataReceived: Charging station records with location, operator, connector types, rated power, EVSE ids, opening hours, and structured per-connector tariffs (energy/time/parking price, currency, VAT)

lt-vialietuva.purpose: Lithuanian national EV charging dataset (Via Lietuva OCPI) covering publicly accessible charging infrastructure in Lithuania, including structured tariffs
lt-vialietuva.dataSent: No query parameters — the full national OCPI locations and tariffs feeds are downloaded server-side on a daily schedule into the local database and then queried by bounding box locally; no user data reaches the provider per map request
lt-vialietuva.dataReceived: Charging station records with location, operator, connector types, rated power, and structured per-connector tariffs (energy/session price, currency, VAT)

kr-datago.purpose: Nationwide EV charging station standard dataset published by Korea Environment Corporation (한국환경공단) via data.go.kr
kr-datago.dataSent: No query parameters beyond the fixed column list — the full dataset is downloaded server-side on a daily schedule via data.go.kr's keyless standard-data endpoint into the local database and then queried by bounding box locally; no user data reaches the provider per map request
kr-datago.dataReceived: Charging station records with name, address, province, slow/fast charger counts, fast-charger connector type, opening hours, closed days, parking-fee flag, managing operator, phone number, and reference date

pl-eipa.purpose: Polish national alternative-fuel/EV charging register (EIPA, run by UDT) covering publicly accessible charging stations in Poland, with live per-point availability and structured PLN pricing
pl-eipa.dataSent: No query parameters — the full national station/point/pricing feed is downloaded server-side on a schedule (authenticated from the environment) into the local database and then queried by bounding box locally; no user data reaches the provider per map request
pl-eipa.dataReceived: Charging station records with location, operator, connector types/power, live per-point availability status, and structured energy (PLN/kWh) and time (PLN/min) pricing

at-econtrol.purpose: E-Control Austria's national Ladestellenverzeichnis — public EV charging stations across Austria with live per-connector status and structured ad-hoc pricing
at-econtrol.dataSent: Latitude/longitude of the searched map area's center, plus the operator's API key and registered Referer domain — sent server-side per map request; no user data reaches the provider
at-econtrol.dataReceived: Charging station records with location, operator, live per-connector status, connector types, rated power, opening hours, and structured energy/time/flat/blocking-fee pricing in EUR

sg-ltadatamall.purpose: Official Singapore EV charging station dataset (LTA DataMall), covering charging point locations, connectors, and real-time availability by postal code
sg-ltadatamall.dataSent: No bounding-box or location parameters — the batch endpoint is called with only the AccountKey header, its pre-signed download link is fetched, and the full national result set is filtered by bounding box locally; a single-station lookup additionally sends the derived 6-digit postal code
sg-ltadatamall.dataReceived: Charging station records with address, coordinates, per-charger operator, connector (plug) types, power rating, charging price, and live per-connector availability status

tw-tdx.purpose: Official Taiwanese national EV charging station dataset (TDX — Transport Data eXchange, Ministry of Transportation and Communications) covering publicly accessible charging infrastructure by city/county, with live per-connector status
tw-tdx.dataSent: Bounding-box coordinates matched against approximate city/county boundaries to pick which TDX city endpoints to query, plus an OAuth2 client-credentials bearer token (obtained server-side from the configured Client ID/Secret) — sent server-side per map request
tw-tdx.dataReceived: Charging station records with location, address, connector types and per-type counts (AC/DC), free-text charging-rate/parking-rate descriptions, opening hours, and live per-connector availability status

opendatasoft.purpose: Opendatasoft (Opendatasoft SAS, France) is the API platform that hosts and serves the French national IRVE charging dataset; requests for French charging points are answered by this platform
opendatasoft.dataSent: The map-viewport bounding box (as an in_bbox(point_geo, north, west, south, east) filter with pagination) reaches the Opendatasoft platform server-side; no user identity, account, or API key is sent
opendatasoft.dataReceived: Charging point records from the hosted IRVE dataset (location, operator, connector types, power, access, payment, pricing, opening hours)

ch-sfoe.purpose: Swiss national charging station dataset (Swiss Federal Office of Energy SFOE) covering public charging infrastructure in Switzerland
ch-sfoe.dataSent: No query parameters — the full national OICP dataset (and a 5-minute live-status feed) is downloaded server-side on a schedule into the local database and then queried by bounding box locally; no user data reaches the provider per map request
ch-sfoe.dataReceived: Charging station records with location, operator, connector/plug types, rated power, accessibility, authentication/payment modes, opening hours, and live availability status

nl-dotnl.purpose: Dutch national charging point dataset (DOT-NL / NDW National Access Point) covering publicly accessible charging infrastructure in the Netherlands
nl-dotnl.dataSent: No query parameters — the full national OCPI locations feed (and its structured tariffs feed) is downloaded server-side on a schedule into the local database and then queried by bounding box locally; no user data reaches the provider per map request
nl-dotnl.dataReceived: Charging station records with location, operator, connector/plug types, rated power, structured tariffs, and live per-connector availability status

no-nobil.purpose: Nordic EV charging station database (NOBIL) covering public charging stations in Norway and Sweden
no-nobil.dataSent: Bounding box as type=rectangle with northeast=(north, east) and southwest=(south, west), plus the NOBIL API key — sent server-side per map request
no-nobil.dataReceived: Charging station records with location, operator/owner, connector types, charging capacity, port counts, accessibility, opening hours, and station status

si-nap.purpose: Official Slovenian national EV charging registry (NAP Slovenija / Prometej IDACS National Access Point) covering public charging infrastructure in Slovenia. Requires a business-entity registration and OAuth2 token; inactive until configured
si-nap.dataSent: No query parameters from the map — the full national DATEX II dataset is downloaded server-side on a daily schedule using an OAuth2 bearer token exchanged from the configured refresh token, into the local database, then queried by bounding box locally; no user data reaches the provider per map request
si-nap.dataReceived: Charging site records with location, address, operator, connector types, rated power, and current type

osm.purpose: EV charging station locations from OpenStreetMap via Overpass (secondary source, global fallback)
osm.dataSent: An Overpass QL query for amenity=charging_station nodes within the bounding box (south, west, north, east) — sent server-side; no API key
osm.dataReceived: OSM charging station nodes with name, operator, socket types, capacity, and fee info
